def transform4(grid, bg=0):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def rows_major(c): return [i for i in range(h) if Counter(grid[i]).most_common(1)[0][0] == c]
    frames = [(len(rs), c) for c in {v for row in grid for v in row}
              for rs in [rows_major(c)] if len(rs) >= 2 and all(b - a > 1 for a, b in zip(rs, rs[1:]))]
    frame = max(frames)[1]
    line_rows = rows_major(frame)
    line_cols = [j for j in range(w) if Counter([grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]).most_common(1)[0][0] == frame]
    rest = [v for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if i not in line_rows and j not in line_cols]
    fill = Counter(rest).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_r = [k for k, i in enumerate(line_rows) if any(grid[i][j] != frame for j in line_cols)]
    marked_c = [k for k, j in enumerate(line_cols) if any(grid[i][j] != frame for i in line_rows)]
    out = []
    for a in range(min(marked_r), max(marked_r)):
        row = []
        for b in range(min(marked_c), max(marked_c)):
            cs = [grid[line_rows[x]][line_cols[y]] for x in (a, a+1) for y in (b, b+1)]
            cnt = Counter(c for c in cs if c not in (frame, bg))
            c, n = cnt.most_common(1)[0] if cnt else (fill, 0)
            row.append(c if n >= 3 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
